Team —

Attached is a short extract (helix_stale_opps_may04.csv) of Helix Health opportunities flagged as "stale" by the forecasting rules (no activity in 30+ days, stage unchanged). We need to run a quick triage so finance has a clean commit by EOD Friday. My asks: 

- Owners: review your rows and update one of the following by Friday EOD PST (may 7): Convert (move to active engagement with next step), Commit (confirm expected close date + proof), or Archive (mark as dead and add reason).
- If you plan to keep an opp but need a little more time, add a clear next step and expected proof point in the HubSpot notes and ping me.
- Marcus: can you run a 1-line check on any opps in Closed Won probability > 60% but with no activity?

I'll consolidate responses and surface any items we need SLT attention on Thursday. Low-touch replies (one-line) are fine — just put the action and expected date.

Thanks —
